mediaShare.intro: Watch your project albums on a TV or open them from any file manager. Every device gets read-only access to the projects you choose.

tv.title: TV mode
tv.desc: A full-screen viewer built for remote controls: browse albums, filter by tags, and play slideshows and videos.
tv.step1: On the TV, open this address in the web browser:
tv.step2: The TV shows a code. Scan its QR code with your phone, or enter the code here:
tv.webos: LG TV owners can also install TV mode as an app on the home screen: see the webOS folder in the repository.

webdav.title: WebDAV network drive
webdav.desc: Mount your albums as a read-only drive in Finder, Windows Explorer, Infuse, rclone or a file manager on your TV.
webdav.tokenCreated: Copy this token now. It won't be shown again.
webdav.httpsNote: Windows Explorer only sends passwords over HTTPS. Finder, Infuse and rclone also work over HTTP.

dlna.title: DLNA media server
dlna.desc: Your TV's built-in photo and video app (LG "Photo & Video", Samsung "Media") finds this server on the local network. Nothing to install.
dlna.disabled: DLNA is off on this server. Set DLNA_ENABLED=true and run the container with host networking (see docker-compose.dlna.yml).
dlna.notRunning: DLNA is enabled but not running: {{error}}
dlna.lanOnly: DLNA has no passwords: anyone on your local network can browse a DLNA server. Limit its projects if that matters.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.message: It loses access to your albums immediately.

link.title: Link a TV
link.desc: Enter the code shown on your TV.
link.request: A TV wants to show your albums
link.done: Linked. Your TV will show your albums in a moment.
link.denied: Declined. The TV was not linked.
